sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Negyed (quarter) behaves just like fél — it goes before the unit word and stays unchanged: negyed kiló, negyed liter.

items.english: Is a quarter kilo enough too?

sections.content: Is (too/also) comes right after the word it modifies: A répa is friss puts is after répa, not at the start of the sentence like English 'too' at the end.
